entities.name: Mário Antônio da Silva
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mário Antônio da Silva is a Brazilian prelate of the Catholic Church who has been the Metropolitan Archbishop of Aparecida since 2026. He was previously the Metropolitan Archbishop of Cuiabá (2022-2026), Bishop of Roraima (2016–2022) and auxiliary bishop of Manaus (2010–2016).
